classes.name: LocalConversation
classes.description: A provider-independent conversation owned and persisted by Aldunis Code.

properties.name: provider
properties.description: The provider adapter bound to the conversation.

properties.name: worktree
properties.description: The canonical local worktree bound to the conversation.

classes.name: DelegatedConversationRelationship
classes.description: A local, metadata-only association from one parent conversation to one existing child conversation. It never transfers messages, provider context, tool state, or approvals.

classes.name: ManagedWorktreeRemovalApproval
classes.description: A short-lived, single-use approval bound to the exact managed checkout inspected during preview. Branch, HEAD, Git administrative directory, filesystem identity, and nanosecond change times must still match before removal.

classes.name: DelegatedConversationOutcomeProjection
classes.description: A beta-gated, read-only UI projection of the latest completed child turn. Its bounded summary is derived from child history and never enters parent provider context.

relations.name: has_delegated_relationship
relations.description: Associates a parent conversation with a durable delegated-conversation relationship.

relations.name: projects_delegated_child
relations.description: Identifies the one existing child conversation projected by a delegated-conversation relationship.

relations.name: projects_quiet_outcome
relations.description: Exposes the latest bounded completed outcome for review without transferring conversation authority.
